recommendation.brokerReasoning: Cohort standard_young_healthy, no declared conditions, no near-term needs, budget band low (ceiling 5,000). Essential at 4,200 is the only plan inside the band and nothing in the record needs what Balanced adds. The 1,500 deductible and 30% co-pay are live exposure but sit against an expected-utilisation profile of near zero. Straightforward placement — no reviewer judgment required beyond a sign-off.
recommendation.memberReasoning: Essential fits what you told us: you want the lowest premium and you have no conditions or planned treatment. It costs 4,200 a year. Two things to know — you pay the first 1,500 of any treatment yourself each year, and after that you pay 30% of outpatient bills. Maternity and pre-existing conditions are not covered on this plan.
